Created skill `officeqa-rsquare-two-series-correlation`.

What was generalizable and worth saving:
- The R² pattern: "R-square of the relationship between two named series" = Pearson correlation squared (r²), symmetric, no regression fit needed. This is distinct from the existing OLS slope/intercept and forecast skills, which a future agent could otherwise over-apply.
- Data location for on-budget vs off-budget receipts (federal budget-results / MTS summary table) and the fact that "nominal" means no inflation adjustment.
- The "use bulletins from September YYYY at 5-year intervals" sourcing pattern — each Sept bulletin carries ~5 trailing fiscal years, so 4 bulletins cleanly cover a 20-year window.
- The inclusive-count and round-only-at-end reminders that match my recurring rounding-stage memory.

No new memory entry needed — memory is near its char cap and this skill captures the durable facts. Done.
